verdict.rationale: TruffleHog supports background automation via hosted/self-hosted scanners that continuously monitor Git, Slack, Jira, Confluence, etc. and route alerts to Slack/Jira/webhooks, which functions as autonomous background scanning, but this is a security-scanning automation, not an AI-agent-oriented workflow. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent/agentic orchestration, scheduling/triggers tailored for AI-native workflows, and independent evidence of unattended long-running automation beyond scan+alert.
